card.name: Reactions "have occurred" in warnings
card.fires_on: The verb right after "have" or "has" (mostly "occurred", sometimes "resulted") in warning text that says a serious reaction has been reported. It follows a named reaction such as anaphylaxis or cardiovascular reactions.

modes.label: have occurred
modes.description: The word "occurred" after "have/has" following a serious reaction in a boxed warning or warnings section.
modes.example: Life-threatening or fatal cardiovascular reactions have<< occurred>> with the use of OPTIRAY,

modes.label: Related verbs
modes.description: Other words that complete the same kind of statement, such as "resulted" or "in" after "have occurred".
modes.example: Seizures have occurred<< in>> CKD patients participating in Mircera

card.plain: It marks the verb in warnings saying that a serious reaction has been reported with a drug.
evidence: Concomitant administration of miconazole and warfarin has<< resulted>> in enhancement of anticoagulant effect
